name: Galeb Duhr
traits: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
Galeb Duhr, also written Galeb-Duhr. Medium Elemental, 15-ft. walking speed, +1 Strength and +1 Constitution. Speaks, reads and writes Terran.
The elemental can go without air, food, drink or sleep and instead rests semiconsciously for 4 hours for the benefit of an ordinary night of sleep.
False Appearance. After a minute motionless and concentrating as for a spell, the elemental blends in as long as it stays still. Use a boulder as the form.

Natural armor is 14 + Dexterity modifier while unarmored. The slam is a 1d8 bludgeoning unarmed strike. Stone Body prevents poison damage and the exhaustion, paralysis, petrification and poisoned conditions.

Start or stop rolling as a bonus action. Rolling doubles the base speed, or quadruples it downhill. While rolling, use the Dash action and a bonus action to slam once or shove once. The follow-up ends the roll.

name: Gargoyle
traits: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
Medium Elemental with 30-ft. walking speed. Choose +1 Strength or +1 Constitution. Speaks, reads and writes Terran.
The elemental can go without air, food, drink or sleep and instead rests semiconsciously for 4 hours for the benefit of an ordinary night of sleep.
False Appearance. After a minute motionless and concentrating as for a spell, the elemental blends in as long as it stays still. Use a statue as the form.
Flies 30 ft. in light armor or while unarmored. Medium or heavy armor prevents this flight. Darkvision 60 ft. cannot distinguish colors in darkness.
Natural armor is 12 + Dexterity modifier while unarmored. Claws are 1d4 slashing unarmed strikes. Stone Body prevents poison damage and the poisoned and petrified conditions.

name: Gibbering Mouther
traits: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
Medium Aberration with +2 Constitution, 20-ft. walking speed and 20-ft. swimming speed. Speaks, reads and writes Common.
The gelatinous body has no arms or hands and cannot wear armor. It cannot wield weapons, wear shields or use gear requiring manipulation. Bites are 1d8 slashing unarmed strikes.

Blinding Spittle. Use an action against one visible creature within 15 ft. It makes a Dexterity save against 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier or is blinded through the end of the mouther's next turn. Recharges on a short or long rest.

Gibber. As an action, each creature within 20 ft. that can hear it rolls a Wisdom save against 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. On a failure, it loses reactions until the start of its next turn. For that turn, roll 1d8. On 1–4 it does nothing. On 5–6 it uses its movement in a random direction and takes no action or bonus action. On 7–8 it makes one melee attack against a random creature in reach, or does nothing if unable. Recharges on a short or long rest.
Trip. After hitting with an unarmed strike, the mouther can use a bonus action to attempt to shove that target prone under the normal shove rules.

name: Grell
traits: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
Medium Aberration with +1 Strength and +1 Dexterity. Walks 10 ft. and speaks Grell.
Eyeless and blind, with 30-ft. blindsight and immunity to the blinded condition. There is no sight beyond its blindsight.
Flies 30 ft. and can hover as long as it wears neither medium nor heavy armor. It is immune to the prone condition.
The character has no hands and cannot wield manufactured weapons, wear shields or use manipulated items such as tools, wands or spellcasting foci. Its beak is a 1d8 slashing unarmed strike.

name: Grick
traits: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
Medium Monstrosity with +1 Strength, +1 Dexterity and +1 Wisdom. Walking and climbing speeds are both 30 ft. Speaks, reads and writes Common.
Darkvision 60 ft. distinguishes shades of gray in darkness. Stone Camouflage grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
Natural armor is 12 + Dexterity modifier while unarmored. Beak and tentacles are 1d8 unarmed strikes, choosing bludgeoning or slashing.
The character has no hands and cannot wield manufactured weapons, wear shields or use manipulated items such as tools, wands or spellcasting foci.
